description: Search for websites by technology and return a count plus sample results. Use this to answer questions like 'how many websites use Shopify?', 'find sites using both Shopify and Braze', or 'show me sites using Klaviyo but not Mailchimp'. Always call get_suggestions first to convert technology names or categories into UUIDs. To require multiple technologies (AND), pass all UUIDs in the 'all' array of the search object. To require one OR more technologies (OR), pass all UUIDs in the 'any' array of the search object. To exclude one or more technologies (NOT), pass all UUIDs in the 'none' array of the search object. Returns total count, sample sites with company info, emails, LinkedIn, country, and spend estimates, and fingerprints for some sites to show the code which matched the search criteria. Supports pagination via the 'start' parameter (0, 25, 50, ...).

query.description: (Deprecated) Raw code snippet to search for. Prefer using the 'search' object instead.

search.description: Boolean search filter. Use 'all' for AND logic, 'any' for OR logic, 'none' to exclude. Each item has a 'type' (code or report) and 'value'. Use get_suggestions first to find report UUIDs for named technologies.

all.description: All of these must match (AND). Typically report UUIDs from get_suggestions.

any.description: At least one of these must match (OR).

none.description: None of these may match (NOT / exclusion).

start.description: Page offset for pagination. Set to 25 for page 2, 50 for page 3, etc. Defaults to 0.

name: search_code
